reason: Suggested chips never return data: (1) chips say 'this month' which resolves to September while the data is July, so chip 1 shows ACTUAL 0.00; (2) the percentage measure is published to the selector as the label '%' so the word 'percentage' does not match - proven: '%' succeeds 3/3, 'percentage' is not_supported 3/3; (3) governed-financial and mis-statement both publish measures labelled 'Actual' and 'Budget', so an unscoped 'Actual' is ambiguous and degrades to a glossary definition - proven: unscoped informational 3/3, domain-qualified success 3/3. MeasureSpec.synonyms exists for exactly this and no measure declares any.
